statusLine.command: jq -r 'def rl(w; tag): if w then "\(tag)(\(w.used_percentage | floor)%)" else empty end; def rst(w; tag; fmt): if w.resets_at? then "\(tag)→\(w.resets_at | strflocaltime(fmt))" else empty end; ([ "\(.model.display_name)\(if .effort.level? then "(\(.effort.level))" else "" end)", "\((.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0) + (.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0) | . / 1000 | floor)k/\((.context_window.context_window_size // 200000) / 1000 | floor)k", rl(.rate_limits.five_hour?; "5h"), rl(.rate_limits.seven_day?; "7d"), (if .pr? then "PR#\(.pr.number)(\(.pr.review_state // "open"))" else empty end) ] | join("  ")) as $l | ([ rst(.rate_limits.five_hour?; "5h"; "%H:%M"), rst(.rate_limits.seven_day?; "7d"; "%a") ] | join(" ")) as $rp | (if $rp == "" then "" else "resets \($rp)" end) as $r | (($ENV.COLUMNS // "120") | tonumber) as $c | ($c - ($l | length) - ($r | length)) as $pad | if $r == "" then $l elif $pad > 0 then $l + (" " * $pad) + $r else "\($l)  \($r)" end'
